threads.body: [General] This plugin version is explicitly required to stay synchronized with `graalvmReachabilityMetadataVersion` (`conventions/src/main/kotlin/otel.spring-native-test-conventions.gradle.kts:12-13`), but that value remains `1.1.8`; `conventions/build.gradle.kts:84` also still compiles the convention against native-gradle-plugin `1.1.8`. Update both companion pins to `1.1.9` so the convention downloads and compiles against the same release that Gradle applies.
